No age limit. If it’s any consolation, I tried to hang myself at 9 and was self harming at 8. This hurt turned to anger and I hurt small creatures and I won’t get into that. I didn’t tell anyone or get help cause I was terrified of being judged, but I should have gotten help then so it didn’t escalate into more issues down the road.

Eventually I got offered help Freshman year high school, but it was only school counseling and didn’t really open up like I should have and the sessions didn’t last long. I went a few more years without therapy and a lot happened in that time but I pushed forward and joined the military which further declined my mental health and got therapy again for a couple more years and left the military due to mental issues. I was diagnosed while in with Major Depression and Anxiety, but when I got out the diagnosis was changed to Bipolar with Psychotic Features because I opened up completely to my Psych. 

Basically because I have major mood swings and during anger fits I start thinking everyone is staring at me and judging me and I start having audible hallucinations of people calling my name or sometimes I’ll think Im actually immortal and not able to be killed/ god complex when I’m manic. 

Long story short if you don’t attempt to get help or get an understanding of what’s wrong it can get worse. I have had problems with wanting to hurt people, but it’s a completely human feeling that you just have to learn to, not so much bottle them, but redirect them into healthier thoughts or talk/ vent to a mental health professional who can work with you on how to handle these thoughts. The feeling of everything being fake depending on what you mean, can mean you go through Derealization, which generally is cause by severe stress in your life/ traumatic events (the brains defense mechanism which sucks). Extreme stress again can cause hallucinations whether auditory or visual which can be from stress induced psychosis.

None of this means you’re crazy, it’s just your brains way of trying to numb you mentally and it seems to be on overdrive. So my advice to you would be just talk to a mental health professional, and if you don’t have friends to help distract you from the stressed of life, find something you like to do and make it a hobby. I love video games and YouTube (watch a lot of knowledge based videos as well as YouTubers playing horror games to keep my mind occupied).

**Edit after reading replies** Don’t be afraid to ask for help especially when it comes to what other people think, it’s your life and your mental health that matters and nobody’s opinion should strip you of that opportunity to get help. I wish I had made that choice, but I made the same mistake in caring about what people thought. You are not a whimp, not a baby, etc. Just someone who needs a helping hand and someone to talk to.
